mochi_checklist.audience: US students, young women and ADHD-leaning planners on Threads who like cute, low-pressure to-do lists; the free version fits a 4-task list, Premium unlocks unlimited lists and all themes.

lists.title: Monday reset
lists.tip: Small and specific beats long and vague.

lists.title: ADHD-friendly morning
items: Meds and a glass of water
Phone, keys, wallet by the door
lists.tip: Put the list where you'll see it before you need it.

lists.title: 15-minute room reset
lists.tip: Set a timer; stop when it rings, even if you're not done.

lists.title: Study session
items: Open only the notes you need
lists.tip: Start with the easiest task to get moving.

lists.title: Grocery run
lists.tip: Shop from the list, not from the aisles.

lists.title: Weekend trip packing
items: One outfit per day plus a spare
lists.tip: Pack the night before, not the morning of.

lists.title: Sunday reset
lists.tip: Future you will thank tonight's you.

lists.title: Work-from-home day
items: Close the laptop at a set time
lists.tip: A clear end time makes the day feel finished.

lists.title: Self-care evening
items: No screens for the last 20 minutes
lists.tip: Rest counts as a task too.

lists.title: Errand day
items: Pay the one bill you keep forgetting
lists.tip: Group errands by location to save trips.

lists.title: Moving week
lists.tip: One box a day adds up fast.

lists.title: Low-energy day
lists.tip: Doing less on purpose is still a plan.

lists.title: Exam week
items: Practice test on the hardest one
Pack pens and ID the night before

lists.title: Before bed
items: Glass of water on the nightstand
lists.tip: A 2-minute plan tonight saves 20 minutes tomorrow.

lumiweather_tomorrow.audience: Taiwan commuters and parents checking at night what they and their kids should wear tomorrow, especially on cold-front and seasonal-change days.

bands.text: 很冷：發熱衣＋毛衣＋厚外套，圍巾手套一起帶；孩子再多一層。
偏冷：長袖＋毛衣或刷毛，外面加一件防風外套。
早晚涼：長袖＋薄外套，洋蔥式穿法方便調整。
舒服：短袖或薄長袖，進冷氣房帶一件薄外套。
溫暖：短袖就好，室內冷氣強的話帶件薄外套。
炎熱：短袖、透氣材質，帽子、防曬和水都要帶。

lumiweather_tomorrow.range_line: 日夜溫差 {range} 度，早上出門多帶一件。
lumiweather_tomorrow.bands_note: Band by Taipei's (min+max)/2; triggers decide whether weather takes the slot outside its rotation day.
